name: Titanium.UI.iOS.DocumentViewer
summary:
A DocumentViewer provides in-app support for managing user interactions with files on the
local system.

examples.title: Document Viewer Example

properties.name: annotation
properties.summary: Custom property list information for the target file.
properties.description: Use this property to pass information about the document type to the app responsible for opening it.

properties.name: name
properties.summary: Name of the file (without the path).
properties.description: Only returns a value after the document has been previewed.

properties.name: title
properties.description:
Use this property to specify the document title that is displayed in the navigation bar.
If not set, it uses the URL path of the loaded document.

properties.name: url
properties.summary: URL of the document being previewed.
properties.description:
Important note: For iOS 11.2 and later, you need to reference this URL
from either the application data directory or temporary directory. Read
more about this change in the "Note for iOS 11.2 and later" paragraph of
the API summary.

inlined.name: DocumentViewerOptions
inlined.summary: A simple object for specifying options when showing or dismissing a [Titanium.UI.iOS.DocumentViewer](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.DocumentViewer).
inlined.description: The `view` property does not apply to the `hide` method.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Indicates whether to animate the transition.

properties.name: view
properties.summary: Anchors the options menu to the specified view.
properties.description:
Only used with the `show` method.

Currently, this property can only be set to a button in the [Titanium.UI.iOS.Toolbar](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Toolbar),
or the window's `leftNavButton` or `rightNavButton` property.

If this property is not specified, the `show` method launches the document in the viewer
without showing the options menu.

methods.name: show
methods.summary: Displays the document viewer over the current view.
methods.description: To show the options menu, set the `view` key of the options object.

events.name: load
events.summary: Fires when the document is previewed.

events.name: menu
events.summary: Fires when the options menu appears before the document is previewed.
